items.label: Stopped for a school bus with its lights flashing
items.lesson: Stop for a school bus with its red lights flashing, in both directions, until the lights go off.

fixture: A browser-only optional m1-school registry entry exercises the real registered adapter. Phaser uses unsmoothed real delta with the unchanged 0.05-second motor/session cap. The actual motor spawns the live bus and native braking earns its check. A stopped approach pose replaces travel to the crossing; actual controller time and children progress are never shortened. A pre-bay pose replaces travel to the finish; native throttle/brake, automatic camera and finish controls complete parking. No encounter flag, judgement, score, result or saved record is injected. Camera aiming poses locate actual rendered controls; the native action key still uses the real raycast.
